title: Target uses unencrypted HTTP
observes: the URL scheme of the target
action: Serve the application over HTTPS and redirect HTTP to HTTPS. Add HSTS once HTTPS is stable.

title: Content-Security-Policy header missing
observes: that the content-security-policy header is absent or empty
action: Send a Content-Security-Policy header with a tight allowlist (default-src 'self' at minimum) and verify in report-only mode first.

title: HSTS policy without max-age
observes: the strict-transport-security value for the max-age directive
action: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a long max-age (e.g. max-age=31536000) and keep includeSubDomains once all subdomains are HTTPS-ready.

title: Cookie set without the Secure flag
action: Add the Secure flag to every cookie (and HttpOnly unless JavaScript must read it). Cookies are evaluated one entry per Set-Cookie header value.

title: X-Content-Type-Options header missing
observes: that the x-content-type-options header is absent or empty
action: Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on all responses and return accurate Content-Type values for served resources.

title: Cookie set without the HttpOnly flag
action: Add the HttpOnly flag to every cookie that JavaScript does not need to read, alongside Secure and an explicit SameSite policy.

title: X-Frame-Options header missing
observes: that the x-frame-options header is absent or empty
action: Send X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN for intentional framing) on every HTML response. Prefer CSP frame-ancestors as the modern equivalent and keep both during migration.

title: Cookie set without the SameSite attribute
action: Add SameSite=Lax (or Strict for sensitive sessions; None only with Secure for intentional third-party use) to every cookie.

title: Referrer-Policy header missing
observes: that the referrer-policy header is absent or empty
action: Send Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin (or tighter) on every response. Keep sensitive identifiers out of URLs regardless of policy.

title: Content-Security-Policy without frame-ancestors
observes: the content-security-policy value for the frame-ancestors directive
action: Add frame-ancestors 'self' (or 'none' for unframed pages) to the policy. Keep X-Frame-Options during migration for older browsers.

title: Wildcard CORS (Access-Control-Allow-Origin *)
observes: the Access-Control-Allow-Origin value against a pattern
action: Immediate: replace the wildcard with the exact origins that must call the API, and send `Vary: Origin` when the value is computed per request. Durable: keep the allowlist in configuration rather than code, and grant each origin only the methods and headers it needs; never combine a wildcard with `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true`, because browsers reject that pair and a reflected-origin workaround re-creates the exposure. Trade-off: callers outside the allowlist stop working, so inventory them before narrowing.

title: Missing Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy response header
observes: that the Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy header is absent or empty
action: Send Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp only on documents that need cross-origin isolation, and make every embedded resource carry CORP or CORS. Leave the header absent on documents that do not need isolation and record that decision.

title: Missing Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy response header
observes: that the Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy header is absent or empty
action: Send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin on pages that do not need popup round-trips, or same-origin-allow-popups where a popup must keep a relationship. Test the OAuth and payment popups before enforcing it site-wide.

title: Missing Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy response header
observes: that the Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy header is absent or empty
action: Send Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin on authenticated responses, and same-site where subdomains legitimately share an asset. Keep cross-origin only for resources that are public by design.

title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security response header
observes: that the Strict-Transport-Security header is absent or empty
action: Send Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains once every subdomain serves HTTPS. Start with a short max-age while validating, then raise it; adding preload is a separate, deliberate step.

title: Missing Permissions-Policy response header
observes: that the Permissions-Policy header is absent or empty
action: Declare the features the application does not use as empty allowlists, for example camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(). Add a directive only where a feature must be delegated to a named origin.

title: Weak Content-Security-Policy (unsafe-inline) header value
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with a per-response nonce or a hash of each inline block, and remove the keyword so a regression is visible.

title: Weak Content-Security-Policy default-src wildcard header value
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Replace the wildcard with an explicit source list, keep `default-src 'self'` and add the hosts, schemes or nonces each directive needs. Use `'none'` for directives the page never uses.

title: Weak HSTS preload directive header value
observes: the Strict-Transport-Security value for the preload directive
action: Add preload only after max-age is at least one year, includeSubDomains is present, every subdomain serves HTTPS, and the host is submitted to the preload list. Removal from that list takes months, so treat the change as long-lived.

title: Weak Strict-Transport-Security max-age header value
observes: the Strict-Transport-Security value against a pattern
action: Send max-age as a bare unsigned integer of at least 31536000, with no quotes and no units, and keep the directive on every HTTPS response.

title: Weak X-Frame-Options (ALLOW-FROM) header value
observes: the X-Frame-Options value against a pattern
action: Express the allowed embedder with Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors, and keep X-Frame-Options: DENY or SAMEORIGIN for clients that predate CSP support.

title: Dangerous HTTP method allowed
observes: the Allow value against a pattern
action: Immediate: stop advertising methods the route does not serve, and make the server reject PUT, DELETE, TRACE and CONNECT with 405 where they are not implemented. Durable: derive the `Allow` list from the route table so it cannot drift, and disable the WebDAV or default servlet handlers that add these methods. The header proves advertisement, not reachability: confirm by sending the method and reading the status, which this passive check cannot do.

title: Server version disclosed (X-AspNet-Version header)
observes: the X-AspNet-Version value against a pattern
action: Immediate: suppress the banner using the control recorded for this stack (enableVersionHeader false), then confirm the header is gone from a success response, an error response and a static asset. Durable: normalise version banners at the reverse proxy or CDN so a framework upgrade cannot reintroduce one, and keep the component patched — hiding a version lowers reconnaissance value but does not fix a vulnerable release.

title: Missing X-DNS-Prefetch-Control response header
observes: that the X-DNS-Prefetch-Control header is absent or empty
action: Send X-DNS-Prefetch-Control: off on pages that link to sensitive or user-specific hosts. Keep the default where prefetch is a deliberate performance choice and the referenced hosts are public.

title: Expect-CT header absent (deprecated header, informational)
observes: that the Expect-CT header is absent or empty
action: No action is required on the response itself: Expect-CT was deprecated because browsers no longer act on it, so its absence is expected and is reported for inventory completeness only. Durable: remove the header from any configuration template that still sets it so a future deployment does not reintroduce a directive nothing enforces, and police Certificate Transparency from the CT logs or from your certificate monitoring instead. Trade-off: if you previously relied on Expect-CT report-only to detect mis-issued certificates, that signal has to move to a CT-log monitor before the header is removed.

title: Missing NEL response header
observes: that the NEL header is absent or empty
action: If the origin has an error collector, send NEL with a report-to group and a max_age, and define that group in Report-To. If there is no collector, record the decision; sending NEL alone has no effect.

title: Missing Origin-Agent-Cluster response header
observes: that the Origin-Agent-Cluster header is absent or empty
action: Send Origin-Agent-Cluster: ?1 on documents that tolerate origin-keyed isolation, and verify that same-site frames still work. Leave the default where a same-site frame relies on synchronous access.

title: Missing Report-To response header
observes: that the Report-To header is absent or empty
action: Define an HTTPS collector and send Report-To with a group name, a max_age and an endpoint, then reference that group from the policy that should report. If no collector exists, record the decision.

title: Missing X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies response header
observes: that the X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies header is absent or empty
action: Send X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies: none while any legacy client can reach the origin, and remove crossdomain.xml files that grant broad access. Where no such client exists, record that the header is unnecessary.

title: Charset-less text/html or text/plain Content-Type
observes: the Content-Type value against a pattern
action: Immediate: declare `charset=utf-8` on every `text/html` and `text/plain` response and make sure the bytes are actually encoded that way, since a declared charset that disagrees with the payload produces mojibake rather than safety. Durable: set the `Content-Type` once in the framework or the reverse proxy instead of per handler, and keep any `<meta charset>` declaration identical to the header so the two cannot disagree. Trade-off: legacy clients that relied on automatic encoding detection now have to honour the declared encoding, which is the intended behaviour but can surface previously hidden encoding bugs.

title: Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy explicitly disables cross-origin isolation
observes: the Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy value against a pattern
action: Immediate: send `Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp` on documents that need cross-origin isolation, or `credentialless` where subresources cannot carry CORP headers. Durable: set it together with `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin`, and keep an inventory of every embedded origin so a new third-party widget is checked before it ships. Trade-off: cross-origin images, scripts and frames that do not opt in stop loading, which will break third-party embeds until they add CORP or CORS headers.

title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy value without cross-origin isolation
observes: the Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy value against a pattern
action: Immediate: send `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin` on application documents so a cross-origin opener cannot retain a handle to the window. Durable: set the header once for the whole application and review OAuth and payment popups, which need `same-origin-allow-popups` instead. Trade-off: `same-origin` severs the `window.opener` relationship some sign-in and checkout flows rely on, so choose the stricter value per route rather than globally.

title: Weak response control (HSTS without includeSubDomains)
observes: the Strict-Transport-Security value for the includeSubDomains directive
action: Add includeSubDomains once every subdomain can serve HTTPS, and keep the policy free of hosts that cannot.

title: Weak response control (protocol-relative Location)
observes: the Location value against a pattern
action: Strengthen the control (absolute https URLs).

title: Weak response control (wildcard Timing-Allow-Origin)
observes: the Timing-Allow-Origin value against a pattern
action: List the origins that must read timing data instead of using the wildcard; if no partner needs the data, omit the header.

title: Django debug page disclosed in a response
action: Disable debug output in production and return a generic error page (a generic error page with a correlation ID).

title: Java stack frame disclosed in a response
action: Disable debug output in production and return a generic error page (a generic error page with a correlation ID).

title: Python traceback disclosed in a response
action: Disable debug output in production and return a generic error page (a generic error page with a correlation ID).

title: HTTP subresource on an HTTPS page
action: Serve every subresource over HTTPS (HTTPS URLs for every script, style, image, and frame).

title: Redirect to another host (Location header)
observes: the Location header host against the target host
action: Redirect only to relative paths or an allow-listed host (a relative path or an allow-listed host).

title: Cache-Control lacks the no-store directive
observes: the Cache-Control value for the no-store directive
action: Immediate: send `Cache-Control: no-store` on responses that carry personal, session or token data, and make sure the value is not overwritten by a CDN or framework default further down the stack. Durable: classify routes as cacheable or non-cacheable in one place and derive the header from that classification, so a new endpoint cannot ship without a policy. Trade-off: no-store prevents browser and intermediary caching, which costs bandwidth on pages that could otherwise be reused; scope it to the responses that actually carry the data.

title: CORS policy trusts the null origin
observes: the Access-Control-Allow-Origin value against a pattern
action: Immediate: remove `null` from the allowlist. `null` is sent by sandboxed iframes, `file://` documents and some redirect chains, so any page that can be framed or opened locally can reach the endpoint with that origin. Durable: keep an explicit allowlist of real origins in configuration and echo only an exact match, with `Vary: Origin`; never treat a missing or opaque origin as trusted. Trade-off: clients that legitimately run from `file://` or a sandboxed frame must move to a real origin.

title: Content-Security-Policy without base-uri
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value for the base-uri directive
action: Immediate: add the missing directive with a restrictive source list — `'none'` or `'self'` unless the application demonstrably needs another origin. Durable: build the policy from a per-directive template in configuration so a new template cannot omit a directive, and add a regression check that fails when a required directive is absent. Trade-off: a strict `frame-ancestors` or `form-action` value can break an embedding partner or a third-party checkout redirect, so inventory those flows before narrowing.

title: Content-Security-Policy without form-action
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value for the form-action directive
action: Immediate: add the missing directive with a restrictive source list — `'none'` or `'self'` unless the application demonstrably needs another origin. Durable: build the policy from a per-directive template in configuration so a new template cannot omit a directive, and add a regression check that fails when a required directive is absent. Trade-off: a strict `frame-ancestors` or `form-action` value can break an embedding partner or a third-party checkout redirect, so inventory those flows before narrowing.

title: Weak Content-Security-Policy (unsafe-eval)
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Immediate: remove `'unsafe-eval'` and replace `eval`, `new Function` and string-argument timers with static code. Durable: keep the policy in `Content-Security-Policy` (not report-only) and add a report endpoint so a reintroduced `eval` is visible before release. Trade-off: some template engines and charting libraries compile expressions at runtime; those need a build-time rewrite or an isolated, nonce-based script rather than an exception in the policy.

title: Database error text disclosed in a response
action: Catch database errors server-side and return a generic message with a correlation ID (a generic error page with a correlation ID).

title: Debug profiler header exposed
observes: the X-Debug-Token value against a pattern
action: Immediate: turn the profiler off outside development. In Symfony this is `web_profiler` disabled with `collect: false` in the production configuration; other frameworks have an equivalent environment switch. Durable: gate the profiler behind an environment check rather than a URL parameter, and add a deployment test that fails when the token header appears in a production response. Trade-off: you lose profiler data from staging-like environments, so keep a dedicated profiling environment instead of enabling it broadly.

title: Directory listing enabled
action: Disable automatic indexes (autoindex off (nginx) or Options -Indexes (Apache)) and remove stray backup or source files from the web root.

title: Server file path disclosed in a response
action: Immediate: stop returning absolute paths in error text; log the full path server-side and return a relative name and a correlation id to the client. Durable: centralise error rendering so every handler uses the same sanitiser, and add a test that greps error responses for the deployment root. Trade-off: a correlation id is less convenient for a developer reading a bug report, but the full path stays available in the log entry the id points at.

title: Node.js stack frame disclosed in a response
action: Disable stack output in production and return a generic error page (a generic error page with a correlation ID).

title: PHP error with a source path disclosed
action: Set display_errors to Off in production and log errors instead (display_errors = Off with log_errors = On).

title: Referrer-Policy sends full URLs (unsafe-url)
observes: the Referrer-Policy value against a pattern
action: Immediate: send `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin` (or a stricter value) instead of a policy that forwards full URLs. Durable: set the policy once for the whole origin and remove per-page overrides, since a single page that lowers it affects every link a user follows from there. Trade-off: analytics and affiliate flows that read the full referrer stop receiving the path; use an explicit query parameter where a partner needs that attribution.

title: Source map reference in a served script
action: Immediate: stop publishing source maps for production bundles, or restrict them to authenticated tooling. Durable: emit maps only in the build profile used for debugging, and serve them from a path the public edge does not route. Trade-off: error monitoring loses readable stack traces unless the maps are uploaded to the monitoring service instead of being served publicly.

title: Weak Content-Security-Policy script-src wildcard header value
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Immediate: replace `*` in `script-src` with the exact script origins, or move to nonces or hashes with `'strict-dynamic'` where the markup allows. Durable: generate the source list from the assets the application actually serves, and keep `default-src` restrictive so an omitted directive cannot fall back to a wildcard. Trade-off: third-party widgets need explicit origins, and narrowing will break any that relied on the wildcard.

title: Cookie sets SameSite=None without Secure
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Send the cookie with both attributes, for example `Set-Cookie: sid=...; SameSite=None; Secure; HttpOnly`. If the cookie does not need to be sent in third-party contexts, prefer `SameSite=Lax` or `SameSite=Strict`, which do not require Secure.

title: Content-Security-Policy delivered in report-only mode
observes: the Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only value against a pattern
action: Promote the policy to the enforcing Content-Security-Policy header once reports are clean, keeping the report-only copy during the transition (an enforcing Content-Security-Policy).

title: X-Content-Type-Options present with a non-nosniff value
observes: the x-content-type-options value against a pattern
action: Send exactly X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and pair it with accurate Content-Type values (nosniff on every response).

title: Content-Type header missing from the response
observes: that the Content-Type header is absent or empty
action: Send an explicit Content-Type on every response, including error responses, and pair it with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff (text/html; charset=utf-8).

title: Content-Security-Policy without object-src or default-src
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Add object-src 'none' (or rely on a restrictive default-src) so plugins and embedded objects cannot load from arbitrary origins.

title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy explicitly set to unsafe-none
observes: the Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy value against a pattern
action: Set Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy to same-origin, or same-origin-allow-popups where popups must keep a relationship.

title: Permissions-Policy grants a powerful feature to every origin
observes: the Permissions-Policy value against a pattern
action: Replace wildcard grants with an explicit allowlist of origins, or close the feature with an empty allowlist (camera=()).

title: CORS allows every HTTP method from any origin
observes: the Access-Control-Allow-Methods value against a pattern
action: List the methods the API actually serves (for example GET, POST, OPTIONS) and keep the origin allowlist explicit.

title: .NET stack frame with source path disclosed in a response
action: Disable developer exception pages in production and return a generic error response with a correlation id.

title: Form submits to a plaintext HTTP action on an HTTPS page
action: Point the form action at an https:// URL, or use a relative action so the browser keeps the page's scheme.

title: Python http.server directory listing exposed
action: Serve an explicit application or static index, disable directory browsing, and remove non-public files from the served tree.

title: Ruby or Rails stack frame disclosed in a response
action: Disable detailed exception rendering in production (config.consider_all_requests_local = false for Rails, or an equivalent handler) and return a generic error page with a correlation id.

title: Werkzeug interactive debugger page disclosed
action: Run production deployments with debug disabled (app.run(debug=False) or the WSGI server default) and return a generic error page.

title: CORS exposes every response header to any origin
observes: the Access-Control-Expose-Headers value against a pattern
action: List the headers the client actually reads (for example X-Total-Count, ETag) instead of exposing all of them.

title: Redirect target carries embedded credentials
observes: the Location value against a pattern
action: Remove credentials from redirect targets and pass authenticated state through a session cookie or a one-time code.

title: Content-Security-Policy connect-src allows every origin
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Replace the wildcard with the explicit API origins the application calls.

title: Content-Security-Policy without default-src
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value for the default-src directive
action: Add a restrictive default-src 'self' (or 'none') so unnamed directives inherit a safe policy.

title: Go panic with goroutine dump disclosed in a response
action: Recover panics at the HTTP boundary (a middleware with recover()) and return a generic error response with a correlation id.

title: phpinfo() configuration page disclosed
action: Delete the diagnostic script from the served tree and treat the disclosed environment values as exposed.

title: Rust panic message with source location disclosed in a response
action: Catch panics at the request boundary (std::panic::catch_unwind or the framework's error layer) and return a generic error response.

title: Git repository metadata served by the web server
action: Deny dot-directories at the web server and deploy build output instead of the working tree.

title: Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors allows every origin
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Replace frame-ancestors * with 'none' or an explicit list of embedding origins.

title: Content-Security-Policy script-src allows plaintext HTTP origins
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Serve every script source over HTTPS and drop http: sources from script-src (upgrade-insecure-requests can help during migration).

title: Refresh header redirects to an absolute URL
observes: the Refresh value against a pattern
action: Remove Refresh-based navigation and use a server-side redirect with a validated target, or restrict the target to a fixed relative path.

title: Content-Security-Policy script-src allows data: scripts
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Remove data: from script-src (and from default-src when script-src is absent) and serve scripts from a fixed HTTPS origin, preferably with a nonce or hash.

title: Basic authentication challenge sent over plaintext HTTP
observes: the WWW-Authenticate value against a pattern
action: Serve the endpoint over HTTPS only and keep HTTP Strict-Transport-Security on the redirect path; replace Basic with a challenge that does not transmit a reusable secret, or restrict Basic to short-lived tokens inside TLS.

title: CORS allows every request header
observes: the Access-Control-Allow-Headers value against a pattern
action: List the request headers the API consumes, for example Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type, Authorization. Make sure no header used for a tenancy or authorization decision can be chosen by a cross-origin caller.

title: Content-Security-Policy base-uri allows every origin
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Set base-uri 'none' unless the application genuinely needs a base element, in which case set base-uri 'self'. Do not rely on default-src: base-uri has no fallback.

title: Content-Security-Policy form-action allows every origin
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Set form-action to the origins that actually receive submissions, for example form-action 'self' https://pay.example. Unlike fetch directives it does not inherit from default-src, so the value must be present on its own.

title: HTTPS response redirects to a plaintext URL
observes: the Location value against a pattern
action: Redirect to an https URL, or to a path-relative target that keeps the current scheme. If a legacy plaintext host is unavoidable, keep the hop free of credentials and have that host redirect straight back to https.

title: CORS allows a plaintext HTTP origin
observes: the Access-Control-Allow-Origin value against a pattern
action: Serve the calling application over HTTPS and list its https origin. If the http origin exists only to redirect, remove it from the CORS allow-list.

title: Content-Security-Policy connect-src allows plaintext HTTP origins
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Permit only https: and wss: sources in connect-src, for example connect-src 'self' https://api.example wss://api.example. Redirect plaintext API hosts to TLS before changing the policy.

title: Content-Security-Policy form-action allows plaintext HTTP submissions
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Permit only https: destinations in form-action, for example form-action 'self' https://pay.example. Serve the receiving endpoint over TLS before narrowing the policy.

title: Content-Security-Policy frame-src allows every origin
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Name the embeddable origins, for example frame-src 'self' https://player.example. Cross-origin frames that need to run script should be isolated with sandbox attributes and a matching Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy.

title: Content-Security-Policy object-src allows every origin
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Set object-src 'none'. Object and embed elements are legacy plugin surfaces; an application that still needs one should name its single origin explicitly.

title: Content-Security-Policy sandbox can remove itself
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Drop allow-same-origin from the sandbox token list, or serve the sandboxed content from a different origin. A document that needs both tokens should not be sandboxed at all, because the sandbox provides no boundary.

title: Content-Security-Policy style-src allows every origin
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: List the stylesheet origins, for example style-src 'self' https://cdn.example. If inline style is required, use a nonce or hash instead of 'unsafe-inline'.

title: Content-Security-Policy worker-src allows every origin
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Name the worker script origins, for example worker-src 'self'. Serve worker scripts from the same origin as the page that creates them.

title: Laravel Whoops error page disclosed
action: Set APP_DEBUG=false in production and render a generic error view. Keep the detailed handler for local development only.

title: Refresh header redirects to a plaintext URL
observes: the Refresh value against a pattern
action: Point the Refresh target at https, or replace Refresh with a 3xx redirect to an https URL. Prefer the Location header: it is the standard mechanism and this header is not required for compatibility.

title: Spring Boot Whitelabel error page disclosed
action: Replace server.error.whitelabel.enabled with a custom error page that returns a generic message and a correct status code. Keep exception details in server logs, not in the response body.

title: X-Frame-Options value is ignored by browsers
observes: the X-Frame-Options value against a pattern
action: Send exactly DENY or SAMEORIGIN, and prefer Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors for new deployments. Remove the header when frame-ancestors is already present and correct.

title: Alt-Svc advertises a cleartext HTTP/2 alternative
observes: the Alt-Svc value against a pattern
action: Stop advertising h2c on internet-facing origins. Publish only TLS-based alternatives (h2, h3) and let HTTP/1.1 clients upgrade through the normal TLS listener.

title: Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy explicitly allows every origin
observes: the Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy value against a pattern
action: Set Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy to same-origin for application responses, or same-site where subdomains legitimately share assets. Keep cross-origin only for resources that are public by design.

title: Content-Security-Policy report-uri uses a plaintext endpoint
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Serve the report collector over HTTPS and list only https:// endpoints in report-uri, or migrate to report-to with an HTTPS endpoint in the Report-To header.

title: Link header points at a plaintext origin
observes: the Link value against a pattern
action: Reference the target with https:// or a scheme-relative form that inherits the document scheme. Keep Link preconnect hints limited to origins that terminate TLS.

title: Referrer-Policy sends full URLs to cross-origin destinations
observes: the Referrer-Policy value against a pattern
action: Use strict-origin-when-cross-origin or same-origin. Both keep the full URL on same-origin navigation and send only the origin, or nothing, across origins.

title: Refresh header uses a protocol-relative target
observes: the Refresh value against a pattern
action: Use a path-relative Refresh target (a single leading slash) or an absolute https URL on an allow-listed host. Do not accept a Refresh value from request input.

title: Report-To names a plaintext endpoint
observes: the Report-To value against a pattern
action: Serve every reporting endpoint over HTTPS and update the Report-To JSON. If the collector is internal, terminate TLS in front of it rather than posting across a plaintext hop.

title: X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies permits every policy file
observes: the X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies value against a pattern
action: Set X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies to none unless a specific legacy client requires otherwise, and remove crossdomain.xml files that grant broad access.

title: Strict-Transport-Security max-age is not a valid delta-seconds value
observes: the Strict-Transport-Security value against a pattern
action: Send max-age as a bare unsigned integer number of seconds, for example max-age=31536000. Validate the value at the framework or proxy layer so a template error cannot ship a non-numeric duration.

title: Framework version disclosed (X-AspNetMvc-Version header)
observes: the X-AspNetMvc-Version value against a pattern
action: Remove the header in the application configuration (MvcHandler.DisableMvcResponseHeader) or at the reverse proxy. Keep version information in server-side inventory rather than in responses.

title: Registry API version disclosed (Docker-Distribution-Api-Version header)
observes: the Docker-Distribution-Api-Version value against a pattern
action: Keep the registry behind authentication and network policy rather than on a public host, and strip the version header at the edge when the registry must face the internet.

title: Internal backend hostname disclosed (X-Backend-Server header)
observes: the X-Backend-Server value against a pattern
action: Strip the header at the edge, or rename the value to an opaque request identifier. If the application sets it for correlation, send that correlation value to the log sink instead of the client.

title: Profiler link exposed (X-Debug-Token-Link header)
observes: the X-Debug-Token-Link value against a pattern
action: Run the profiler only in development, and strip X-Debug-Token and X-Debug-Token-Link in production. If the profiler must run, restrict it to a trusted network and rotate the debug token store.

title: Apache mod_status page disclosed in a response
action: Restrict /server-status to localhost with the mod_status Require directive, or disable the module on internet-facing virtual hosts.

title: ASP.NET Core developer exception page disclosed in a response
action: Run the application with the Production environment name so the developer exception page is not registered, and return a generic error page instead.

title: Environment file contents disclosed in a response
action: Stop serving dotfiles from the document root, move the environment file outside it, and rotate every secret it contained.

title: Elasticsearch cluster info disclosed in a response
action: Put Elasticsearch behind authentication and a network policy, and never route the HTTP port to the internet. Rename the cluster so the default name is not the only barrier to cross-cluster search.

title: etcd version endpoint disclosed in a response
action: Authenticate etcd, enable TLS on the client port and keep it on a private network. Rotate any secret whose key space was reachable.

title: Go pprof profiling index disclosed in a response
action: Remove the net/http/pprof handler from the public mux (import it only on an internal listener), or require authentication and a private network path.

title: GraphQL introspection result disclosed in a response
action: Disable introspection in production (or allow it only for authenticated tooling) and keep the schema in the build pipeline where it belongs.

title: Prometheus metrics endpoint disclosed in a response
action: Require authentication on /metrics or scrape it over a private network path, and drop high-cardinality labels that carry user or path data.

title: better_errors debug page disclosed in a response
action: Remove the better_errors gem from the production bundle and keep it in the development group of the Gemfile.

title: Object storage bucket listing disclosed in a response
action: Remove the public list permission from the bucket policy and enable Block Public Access. Review the listed keys for objects that should not have been public.

title: Spring Actuator environment endpoint disclosed in a response
action: Disable the actuator env endpoint or require authentication and a management port that is not publicly routed. Rotate any credential that appeared in the response.

title: Spring Actuator index disclosed in a response
action: Require authentication on the management port, or disable the discovery endpoint. Review whether every endpoint the index lists is meant to be reachable.

title: Swagger UI documentation exposed in a response
action: Serve the documentation only on an internal or authenticated path, and remove it from the production image when it is generated at build time.

title: Apache Tomcat error report disclosed in a response
action: Configure a custom error page for the application and suppress the Tomcat version banner (server.info), so the container does not render its own report to clients.

title: Oracle WebLogic error page disclosed in a response
action: Configure custom error pages at the application level so WebLogic does not render its own error page, and keep the container version out of responses.

title: WildFly or JBoss error report disclosed in a response
action: Deploy a custom error page and turn off the container's default error handling so the server does not render Undertow diagnostics to clients.

title: Access-Control-Allow-Origin uses a wildcard inside an origin
observes: the Access-Control-Allow-Origin value against a pattern
action: Return one exact origin, echoed from a server-side allowlist after comparing the request's Origin header, or return the literal * when the response is not credentialed. Remove host-pattern support from the CORS helper that produced the value.

title: Access-Control-Allow-Origin is not a bare origin
observes: the Access-Control-Allow-Origin value against a pattern
action: Compare the request Origin against an allowlist and echo the origin exactly, with no path, no trailing slash and no query. Fix the helper so configuration values are parsed as URLs and reduced to scheme, host and port.

title: Content-Security-Policy child-src allows a wildcard source
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Replace the wildcard in child-src with the explicit origins that must be reachable, and use 'none' or 'self' where no third-party origin is needed. If the wildcard was added to unblock a single vendor, name that vendor's origin instead so the policy keeps recording intent.

title: Content-Security-Policy font-src allows a wildcard source
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Replace the wildcard in font-src with the explicit origins that must be reachable, and use 'none' or 'self' where no third-party origin is needed. If the wildcard was added to unblock a single vendor, name that vendor's origin instead so the policy keeps recording intent.

title: Content-Security-Policy img-src allows a wildcard source
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Replace the wildcard in img-src with the explicit origins that must be reachable, and use 'none' or 'self' where no third-party origin is needed. If the wildcard was added to unblock a single vendor, name that vendor's origin instead so the policy keeps recording intent.

title: Content-Security-Policy manifest-src allows a wildcard source
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Replace the wildcard in manifest-src with the explicit origins that must be reachable, and use 'none' or 'self' where no third-party origin is needed. If the wildcard was added to unblock a single vendor, name that vendor's origin instead so the policy keeps recording intent.

title: Content-Security-Policy media-src allows a wildcard source
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Replace the wildcard in media-src with the explicit origins that must be reachable, and use 'none' or 'self' where no third-party origin is needed. If the wildcard was added to unblock a single vendor, name that vendor's origin instead so the policy keeps recording intent.

title: Content-Security-Policy carries an obsolete or removed directive
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Remove the obsolete directive and express the same intent with a control that is still implemented: frame-ancestors or the Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy header instead of disown-opener, Referrer-Policy instead of the referrer directive, and object-src 'none' instead of plugin-types.

title: Content-Security-Policy sandbox grants both allow-scripts and allow-same-origin
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Drop one of the two tokens. A frame that must run script should not keep its origin (allow-scripts alone), and a frame that must keep its origin should not run script. Serve untrusted content from a separate origin instead of weakening the sandbox.

title: Content-Security-Policy script-src-elem allows a wildcard source
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Replace the wildcard in script-src-elem with the explicit origins that must be reachable, and use 'none' or 'self' where no third-party origin is needed. If the wildcard was added to unblock a single vendor, name that vendor's origin instead so the policy keeps recording intent.

title: Content-Security-Policy strict-dynamic without a nonce or hash
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Add a per-response nonce (or a hash of the allowed inline script) to script-src alongside 'strict-dynamic', and template the nonce into the script tags the page emits. Keep the host allowlist only for browsers that do not support strict-dynamic.

title: Strict-Transport-Security delivered over plaintext HTTP
observes: the Strict-Transport-Security value against a pattern
action: Serve HSTS only from the HTTPS listener, and make the HTTP listener answer with a redirect to HTTPS that does not pretend to set the policy. Check the proxy configuration for an add_header rule that is applied to both listeners.

title: Origin-Agent-Cluster explicitly disables origin-keyed agent clustering
observes: the Origin-Agent-Cluster value against a pattern
action: Send Origin-Agent-Cluster: ?1, or omit the header on browsers whose default is already origin-keyed. Keep ?0 only where a document genuinely depends on sharing an agent cluster with another origin, and record that dependency.

title: Referrer-Policy names no policy a browser recognises
observes: the Referrer-Policy value against a pattern
action: Use one of the defined policy tokens, spelled exactly (no-referrer, same-origin, strict-origin-when-cross-origin and the other five). Add a test that fails when the configured value is not in the allowed list, because a misspelled token fails silently in the browser.

title: Refresh header targets a script scheme
observes: the Refresh value against a pattern
action: Build the Refresh target from a fixed allowlist of paths, not from request data, and never emit a script scheme. Prefer an HTTP 3xx redirect, which cannot carry a script scheme, and treat any existing javascript: target in configuration as a defect to remove.

title: Set-Cookie carries an unrecognised SameSite value
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Send one of the three defined values, spelled exactly: SameSite=Strict, SameSite=Lax or SameSite=None together with Secure. Fix the template or framework setting that produced the misspelling so the attribute cannot regress.

title: X-DNS-Prefetch-Control explicitly enables DNS prefetching
observes: the X-DNS-Prefetch-Control value against a pattern
action: Send X-DNS-Prefetch-Control: off on authenticated and administrative pages, or omit the header and rely on the browser default for the pages where prefetching is useful.

title: Apache Airflow interface disclosed
action: Keep the Airflow web server on an internal network behind an authenticating proxy, enable its authentication backend, and do not expose it through the application ingress.

title: HashiCorp Consul UI disclosed
action: Keep the Consul UI on the internal network, enable ACLs, and bind the HTTP listener to a management interface rather than the application ingress.

title: CouchDB HTTP API root disclosed
action: Require the admin credentials, create named users, bind the interface to the internal network, and keep the version patched.

title: Docker daemon API info disclosed
action: Never expose the Docker daemon TCP socket. Bind it to a local socket, and if remote access is required put an authenticating TLS proxy in front of it with client certificates.

title: Cloud Storage bucket listing disclosed
action: Remove the allUsers storage.objects.list grant, keep the bucket private, and serve public assets through a controlled endpoint or a signed URL.

title: Grafana interface disclosed
action: Keep Grafana on an internal network behind an authenticating proxy, disable anonymous access, and do not expose it through the application ingress.

title: Hadoop NameNode UI disclosed
action: Keep the NameNode UI on the internal network behind an authenticating proxy and enable the Hadoop HTTP authentication setting where the UI must be reachable.

title: Jaeger tracing UI disclosed
action: Keep the Jaeger query service on an internal network behind an authenticating proxy and restrict trace retention to what is needed.

title: JFrog Artifactory interface disclosed
action: Keep Artifactory on the internal network behind an authenticating proxy, require authentication for browsing, and keep the version patched.

title: Jupyter notebook server disclosed
action: Require the server token on every interface, bind the server to loopback, and place it behind an authenticating proxy. Never expose the notebook server on an application ingress.

title: Kibana interface disclosed
action: Keep Kibana on an internal network behind an authenticating proxy and disable anonymous access. Do not publish it through the application ingress.

title: Kubernetes API server version endpoint disclosed
action: Restrict the Kubernetes API server to the control-plane network and to authenticated callers, and do not publish it through the same ingress as the application. Anonymous access to /version is disabled by default in supported releases; re-check the API server flags if it is enabled.

title: Azure Blob Storage container listing disclosed
action: Set the container access level to private and serve public assets through a controlled endpoint or a signed URL. Review the container policy for anonymous read.

title: Kubernetes Dashboard interface disclosed
action: Keep the dashboard on an internal network behind an authenticating proxy, or remove it where it is not required. Do not publish it through the same ingress as application traffic.

title: Kubelet pod list disclosed
action: Disable the kubelet read-only port or set authentication and authorization on the kubelet, and restrict the node network. Anonymous access to the kubelet API is not a supported configuration.

title: Nexus Repository interface disclosed
action: Keep the repository manager on the internal network behind an authenticating proxy, require authentication for browsing, and keep the version patched.

title: phpMyAdmin login interface disclosed
action: Do not publish phpMyAdmin beyond the management network. Put it behind an authenticating proxy and an IP allow-list, and keep the version patched.

title: Portainer interface disclosed
action: Keep Portainer on the management network behind an authenticating proxy and never publish it through the application ingress.

title: RabbitMQ management interface disclosed
action: Keep the management plug-in on an internal listener behind an authenticating proxy, or disable it where it is not needed. Do not publish it through the application ingress.

title: Apache Solr admin interface disclosed
action: Keep the Solr admin interface on the management network or behind an authenticating proxy, disable the admin UI where it is not needed, and keep the version patched.

title: SonarQube interface disclosed
action: Keep SonarQube on an internal network behind an authenticating proxy, force authentication for project visibility, and keep the version patched.

title: Apache Spark master UI disclosed
action: Keep the Spark master UI on the internal network and enable the authentication filter. Do not publish port 8080 through the application ingress.

title: Spring Actuator health details disclosed
action: Set management.endpoint.health.show-details to never or to when-authorized, and keep the management port on the internal network rather than the application port.

title: Zabbix interface disclosed
action: Keep Zabbix on an internal network behind an authenticating proxy, require authentication, and keep the front end patched.

title: ZooKeeper stat command output disclosed
action: Disable the four-letter commands with the whitelist configuration, or restrict them to the management network. Keep the client port off untrusted networks.

title: Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy value is not a recognised token
observes: the Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy value against a pattern
action: Set Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy to `require-corp` (or `credentialless` where that is the deliberate choice). Check the spelling against the specification rather than a framework default.

title: Set-Cookie declares SameSite more than once
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Emit exactly one SameSite attribute per cookie. If a framework contributes one, remove the hand-written copy rather than appending a second.

title: Set-Cookie Max-Age is not a valid integer
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Write Max-Age as a decimal number of seconds. If both Max-Age and Expires are sent, make them agree so no user agent has to choose between them.

title: Set-Cookie Path attribute is not absolute
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Write Path with a leading slash, normally `Path=/`, and scope it to the narrowest directory that needs the cookie.

title: Secure cookie attribute delivered over plaintext HTTP
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Serve the endpoint over HTTPS and mark the cookie Secure there. Redirect plaintext requests to HTTPS before any Set-Cookie is emitted rather than issuing the cookie on the plaintext response.

title: Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy value is not a recognised token
observes: the Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy value against a pattern
action: Set Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy to one of the three defined tokens and verify the spelling. Use `same-origin` for resources that should never be embedded cross-origin.

title: Access-Control-Allow-Credentials carries an unrecognised token
observes: the Access-Control-Allow-Credentials value against a pattern
action: Emit exactly `true` when credentialed access is intended and remove the header otherwise. Do not pass the flag through a formatter that can spell it differently.

title: Access-Control-Max-Age is not a delta-seconds value
observes: the Access-Control-Max-Age value against a pattern
action: Write Access-Control-Max-Age as decimal seconds. Keep the value within the range browsers accept and document the chosen period beside the allow-list.

title: Access-Control-Allow-Origin carries no host
observes: the Access-Control-Allow-Origin value against a pattern
action: Replace the bare scheme with the exact origin the client uses, including any non-default port, or with the literal `*` if the resource really is public.

title: Access-Control-Allow-Origin names more than one origin
observes: the Access-Control-Allow-Origin value against a pattern
action: Emit one origin per response, chosen from the request's Origin against an explicit allow-list. Never concatenate several origins into one header value.

title: Access-Control-Allow-Origin carries userinfo
observes: the Access-Control-Allow-Origin value against a pattern
action: Compare a parsed origin object against an allow-list and emit `origin.scheme://origin.host[:port]`. Never copy a URL string into the header.

title: Content-Security-Policy default-src allows data: URLs
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Remove `data:` from default-src and name the classes that genuinely need it, such as img-src, in their own directive. Keep script-src and object-src explicit so the fallback cannot reach them.

title: Content-Security-Policy default-src allows plaintext HTTP sources
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Remove `http:` from default-src and name the exact HTTPS origins that are needed. If a legacy origin still serves over HTTP, terminate TLS in front of it and list the HTTPS name instead of relaxing the directive.

title: Content-Security-Policy font-src allows plaintext HTTP sources
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Remove `http:` from font-src and name the exact HTTPS origins that are needed. If a legacy origin still serves over HTTP, terminate TLS in front of it and list the HTTPS name instead of relaxing the directive.

title: Content-Security-Policy frame-src allows plaintext HTTP sources
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Remove `http:` from frame-src and name the exact HTTPS origins that are needed. If a legacy origin still serves over HTTP, terminate TLS in front of it and list the HTTPS name instead of relaxing the directive.

title: Content-Security-Policy img-src allows plaintext HTTP sources
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Remove `http:` from img-src and name the exact HTTPS origins that are needed. If a legacy origin still serves over HTTP, terminate TLS in front of it and list the HTTPS name instead of relaxing the directive.

title: Content-Security-Policy media-src allows plaintext HTTP sources
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Remove `http:` from media-src and name the exact HTTPS origins that are needed. If a legacy origin still serves over HTTP, terminate TLS in front of it and list the HTTPS name instead of relaxing the directive.

title: Content-Security-Policy object-src allows plaintext HTTP sources
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Remove `http:` from object-src and name the exact HTTPS origins that are needed. If a legacy origin still serves over HTTP, terminate TLS in front of it and list the HTTPS name instead of relaxing the directive.

title: Content-Security-Policy script-src allows unsafe-hashes
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Remove `'unsafe-hashes'` and move the handler bodies into nonce-approved script blocks. Where a legacy handler must stay, rewrite it as an addEventListener call in an external script that the policy already allows.

title: Content-Security-Policy script-src allows wasm-unsafe-eval
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Remove `'wasm-unsafe-eval'` unless the page genuinely needs WebAssembly, and keep `'unsafe-eval'` absent. If a single module is required, pin the script source that delivers it and document the exception.

title: Content-Security-Policy style-src allows plaintext HTTP sources
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Remove `http:` from style-src and name the exact HTTPS origins that are needed. If a legacy origin still serves over HTTP, terminate TLS in front of it and list the HTTPS name instead of relaxing the directive.

title: Content-Security-Policy style-src allows unsafe-hashes
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Remove `'unsafe-hashes'` from style-src and move the trusted declarations into a stylesheet the policy already allows. Replace attribute styles with classes.

title: Content-Security-Policy worker-src allows plaintext HTTP sources
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Remove `http:` from worker-src and name the exact HTTPS origins that are needed. If a legacy origin still serves over HTTP, terminate TLS in front of it and list the HTTPS name instead of relaxing the directive.

title: Link header names a script or data URL
observes: the Link value against a pattern
action: Emit Link targets as absolute https URLs on hosts you operate, and drop any hint whose target is not a web address. Resource hints should never name a data or script scheme.

title: Location header names a script or data scheme
observes: the Location value against a pattern
action: Restrict Location to absolute https URLs or to paths on the same host, and reject any value whose scheme is not http or https before sending it. Never reflect a request parameter into Location without that check.

title: Permissions-Policy allow-list is not closed
observes: the Permissions-Policy value against a pattern
action: Close every allow-list and separate features with commas, for example `camera=(self), microphone=()`. Validate the header with a parser before shipping a policy change.

title: Refresh header targets a data: URL
observes: the Refresh value against a pattern
action: Restrict Refresh to absolute https URLs on hosts you operate, and prefer a server-side redirect with a validated Location. Reject data: and script schemes before emitting the header.

title: X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies value is not a recognised token
observes: the X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies value against a pattern
action: Use one of the five defined tokens, normally `none`. Remove values invented by a framework or copied from an unrelated deployment.

title: Adminer database console disclosed
action: Remove Adminer from production, or restrict it to the management network behind an authenticating proxy. Never leave the login page on the application ingress.

title: Prometheus Alertmanager UI disclosed
action: Require authentication in front of Alertmanager, keep it on the internal network, and alert on silence creation from unexpected sources.

title: Argo CD GitOps console disclosed
action: Require SSO in front of Argo CD, keep the server on the internal network, and restrict the default admin account.

title: AWS credentials file served
action: Remove the file from the web root, deactivate the exposed access keys, and issue replacements that are delivered through an instance role or a secret manager rather than a file.

title: Clockwork debug toolbar disclosed
action: Disable Clockwork outside development and confirm production responses carry no toolbar markup or profiling endpoint.

title: Docker client configuration served
action: Remove the file from the web root, revoke the registry credentials it holds, and issue per-host tokens through a credential helper instead of a configuration file.

title: Drupal version in generator meta tag
action: Remove the generator meta tag where the site does not need it and keep core and contributed modules updated.

title: ELMAH error log disclosed
action: Restrict the elmah.axd path to administrators or remove the module from production, and purge existing log entries.

title: GraphQL IDE interface disclosed
action: Disable the IDE in production builds, or serve it only to authenticated developers behind a separate host. Keep introspection restricted to the audiences that need it.

title: H2 database console disclosed
action: Disable spring.h2.console.enabled outside development, and never expose the console on a network interface. If it is needed, bind it to loopback and require the database password.

title: Harbor registry UI disclosed
action: Require authentication for project browsing, keep the UI on the internal network, and restrict anonymous pull to projects that need it.

title: Password file with hash records served
action: Remove the file from the web root, move authentication data outside the document root, and rotate the passwords for every account listed.

title: Jenkins dashboard disclosed
action: Require authentication for the dashboard and disable anonymous read access. Restrict the controller to the internal network.

title: Jenkins script console disclosed
action: Require authentication and an administrative role for the script console, restrict Jenkins to the internal network, and confirm that anonymous read access is disabled.

title: Joomla version in generator meta tag
action: Remove or genericise the generator meta tag and keep core and extensions updated.

title: Keycloak administration console disclosed
action: Restrict the admin console to the management network, require strong administrator credentials with MFA, and disable the temporary admin account after realm setup.

title: Kubernetes kubeconfig served
action: Remove the file from the web root, revoke the embedded credential (delete the token secret or the client certificate), and issue short-lived credentials through a workload identity instead of a kubeconfig file.

title: Laravel Ignition error page disclosed
action: Set APP_DEBUG=false in production and confirm the generic error page is returned. Ignition should not be reachable on a production host.

title: Memcached statistics disclosed
action: Bind memcached to loopback or a private interface, enable SASL authentication where a network client needs it, and never expose the client port to untrusted networks.

title: MinIO object-storage console disclosed
action: Keep the console on the internal network behind an authenticating proxy and issue scoped service accounts instead of root credentials.

title: MongoDB HTTP interface disclosed
action: Bind MongoDB to a private interface, enable authentication and role-based access, and never publish the driver port on an application ingress.

title: nginx stub_status page disclosed
action: Restrict the stub_status location to loopback or an internal monitoring network with an allow directive, or remove it.

title: HashiCorp Nomad UI disclosed
action: Enable ACLs for the UI, keep it on the management network, and require a token through an authenticating proxy.

title: npm authentication token file served
action: Remove the file from the web root, revoke the token at the registry, and deliver registry credentials through CI secrets or a short-lived OIDC exchange rather than a committed file.

title: OpenAPI specification served
action: Publish the description only to authenticated developers, and remove internal or administrative routes from the published subset. Where a public description is required, generate it without the internal operations.

title: package.json manifest served from the web root
action: Serve the built application rather than its source manifest, and keep manifests outside the document root. Where a package identity is genuinely public, publish it from the registry instead.

title: PHP Debug Bar toolbar disclosed
action: Disable the debug bar outside development and confirm production responses carry no toolbar markup.

title: PHP-FPM status page disclosed
action: Restrict pm.status_path to localhost through the web server, or disable it. Never publish it on the public interface.

title: Private key material served in a response
action: Remove the file from the web root and rotate the key, because a served key must be treated as compromised. Store key material outside the document root and check for accidental inclusion in deployment artefacts.

title: Database dump with schema statements served
action: Remove the dump from the web root and move exports to a private store with access control. Treat the data as disclosed and assess notification duties for the rows it contained.

title: Symfony profiler toolbar disclosed
action: Disable the web profiler outside development (web_profiler toolbar false, debug false), clear the profiler store, and confirm the toolbar is absent from production pages.

title: Terraform state file served
action: Move the state to an encrypted remote backend with access control, treat this copy as disclosed, and rotate every credential the state contains. Add the state path to the deny list at the web server.

title: Tomcat manager application disclosed
action: Remove the manager application from production, or restrict it to an administrative network with a manager role and a strong credential. Never publish /manager on the application ingress.

title: Traefik dashboard disclosed
action: Keep the dashboard on the internal network or disable it, and require authentication through a middleware when it must be reachable.

title: HashiCorp Vault UI disclosed
action: Keep the Vault UI on the management network behind an authenticating proxy, and never expose the listener on the application ingress.

title: ASP.NET web.config served with settings
action: Configure the server to refuse requests for configuration files, remove the file from the static root, and rotate every credential the file contains.

title: WordPress version in generator meta tag
action: Remove the generator meta tag from the theme and keep the core and plugins updated. Version hiding is defence in depth, not a substitute for patching.

title: Cache-Control declares public and no-store together
observes: the Cache-Control value against a pattern
action: State one caching intent per response. For per-user data use `no-store`; for shareable content drop no-store and keep the freshness directives.

title: Multipart Content-Type omits the boundary parameter
observes: the Content-Type value against a pattern
action: Send the boundary parameter with the multipart type and keep it unpredictable. Where the body is not multipart, use the type that describes it.

title: Access-Control-Allow-Headers permits Authorization
observes: the Access-Control-Allow-Headers value against a pattern
action: Do not permit Authorization cross-origin unless a specific, small set of origins must send it. Keep the origin allow-list explicit and never reflect arbitrary origins beside a credential-bearing endpoint.

title: Access-Control-Allow-Methods permits TRACE
observes: the Access-Control-Allow-Methods value against a pattern
action: Remove TRACE from Access-Control-Allow-Methods and disable the method at the server. Advertise only the verbs the API actually serves.

title: Expires header is not a valid HTTP date
observes: the Expires value against a pattern
action: Send an HTTP date, or drop Expires and express the lifetime with Cache-Control max-age. Never use the legacy `0` or `-1` sentinels.

title: Obsolete Feature-Policy header present
observes: the Feature-Policy value against a pattern
action: Move every directive to Permissions-Policy, which uses `feature=(allow-list)` syntax, and remove Feature-Policy once the translation is verified.

title: Removed Public-Key-Pins header present
observes: the Public-Key-Pins value against a pattern
action: Remove Public-Key-Pins and rely on HSTS plus certificate transparency monitoring. If pinning is required, implement it in the client rather than through a removed header.

title: X-UA-Compatible forces a legacy document mode
observes: the X-UA-Compatible value against a pattern
action: Remove X-UA-Compatible and serve standards mode. If an intranet client genuinely needs a legacy mode, scope the header to that deployment rather than to every response.

title: Obsolete X-XSS-Protection auditor enabled
observes: the X-XSS-Protection value against a pattern
action: Send `X-XSS-Protection: 0` or omit the header, and rely on a Content-Security-Policy for script control.

title: Docker Compose file served
action: Remove deployment descriptors from the web root and pass secrets through the orchestrator's secret store rather than environment literals in a committed file.

title: WordPress wp-config.php served
action: Refuse requests for .php files that are not entry points, remove the file from any served directory, and rotate the database password and salts, because a served configuration must be treated as disclosed.

title: Content-Type declares the UTF-7 charset
observes: the Content-Type value against a pattern
action: Serve `utf-8` (or another modern charset) and remove any code path that can select utf-7 from a request. Declare the charset explicitly on every text response.

title: Set-Cookie Expires value is not an HTTP date
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Write Expires as an HTTP date in the form `Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT`, or use Max-Age and let the user agent compute the date.

title: Set-Cookie __Host- prefix is paired with a Domain attribute
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Drop the Domain attribute from `__Host-` cookies and keep `Path=/`; if a subdomain must share the value, use a different cookie name and accept that it is not host-locked.

title: Set-Cookie uses SameSite=None without the Partitioned attribute
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Add `Partitioned` beside `SameSite=None` where the cookie must work in an embedded context, and confirm the top-level site supports partitioned cookies. Where embedding is not required, use `SameSite=Lax` or `Strict` instead.

title: Content-Security-Policy declares a directive more than once
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Emit each directive once. Where a framework concatenates policies, build one directive per name and assert the result before shipping; a duplicate is a merge bug, not a policy choice.

title: Content-Security-Policy manifest-src allows plaintext HTTP sources
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Remove `http:` from manifest-src and serve the manifest from an HTTPS origin you control.

title: Content-Security-Policy script-src trusts every subdomain of an origin
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Replace the subdomain wildcard with the exact hostnames that must serve scripts, and keep an inventory of those hosts. If a wildcard is unavoidable, monitor certificate transparency and DNS for new subdomains.

title: Content-Security-Policy nonce is too short to be unguessable
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Generate the nonce from a cryptographically secure random source with at least 128 bits of entropy, and re-issue it on every response. Sixteen base64 characters is the practical floor; most frameworks default to more.

title: Permissions-Policy grants a device-access feature to every origin
observes: the Permissions-Policy value against a pattern
action: Deny device features with `feature=()` unless a specific origin needs them, and name that origin explicitly instead of `*`. Review the list whenever an embed is added.

title: Base element points relative URLs at a plaintext origin
action: Point the base element at an HTTPS URL on the same origin, and avoid a base element entirely when relative URLs already resolve correctly.

title: Envoy administration interface disclosed
action: Bind the Envoy admin listener to localhost or a management network, and never route /server_info, /config_dump, /clusters or /stats through the public listener.

title: HAProxy statistics report disclosed
action: Require authentication on the HAProxy stats listener and bind it to a management interface; remove the stats enable directive from the public frontend.

title: Anchor element uses the javascript: scheme
action: Replace javascript: URLs with a button and an event handler in a bundled script, and keep the policy free of `unsafe-inline` for script-src.

title: Meta refresh navigates an HTTPS page to a plaintext URL
action: Point the meta refresh at an HTTPS URL, or remove the element and navigate from application code where the target scheme can be checked.

title: Plugin object or embed loads over plaintext HTTP on an HTTPS page
action: Load the embedded document over HTTPS, or remove the element. Where a legacy origin cannot serve TLS, terminate TLS in front of it and reference the HTTPS name.

title: pgAdmin management interface disclosed
action: Remove pgAdmin from public routes and reach it through a bastion or VPN; if it must be exposed, put it behind SSO and restrict the source ranges.

title: Selenium Grid status endpoint disclosed
action: Do not expose the Grid hub or router beyond CI networks; enable Grid authentication and restrict /status and /session to the orchestrator.

title: Vite development server serving the application
action: Serve a production build instead of the dev server. If the dev server must run on a shared host, bind it to localhost and never route it through the public listener.

title: Set-Cookie __Host- prefix is not paired with Path=/
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Emit `__Host-` cookies with `Path=/` and without `Domain`. If the cookie only belongs to a sub-path, drop the `__Host-` prefix and use `__Secure-` with an explicit Path instead.

title: Set-Cookie Max-Age exceeds the 400-day browser cap
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Set Max-Age to the lifetime the product actually needs, at most 400 days (34,560,000 seconds), and refresh the cookie on use instead of extending the declared lifetime.

title: Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors allows a plaintext HTTP parent
observes: the Content-Security-Policy value against a pattern
action: Replace `http:` origins in frame-ancestors with their `https:` form, and remove parents that cannot serve TLS.

title: Permissions-Policy grants the Payment Request API to every origin
observes: the Permissions-Policy value against a pattern
action: Restrict payment to the origins that need it (`payment=(self)`) and add an explicit allowlist only for first-party payment frames.

title: Permissions-Policy grants a Privacy Sandbox API to every origin
observes: the Permissions-Policy value against a pattern
action: Leave Privacy Sandbox APIs disabled unless the product needs them, and where they are needed name the exact origins in the allowlist instead of `*`.

title: Server-Timing exposes backend timing to every client
observes: the Server-Timing value against a pattern
action: Emit Server-Timing only on responses that need it, keep metric names generic, and strip the header at the edge for unauthenticated traffic instead of describing internal services.

title: X-B3-TraceId exposes internal tracing identifiers
observes: the X-B3-TraceId value against a pattern
action: Generate a request id for the client at the edge and keep B3 headers inside the service mesh; do not return X-B3-* headers on public responses.

title: X-Runtime exposes per-request processing time
observes: the X-Runtime value against a pattern
action: Disable the X-Runtime header in production (`config.action_dispatch.return_only_request_media_type_on_content_type` era middleware, or an edge rule that strips it) and keep timing details in server-side metrics.

title: SQL Server client exception text disclosed in a response
action: Enable custom errors in ASP.NET and return a generic page with a correlation id. Log the SqlException server-side.

title: MySQL server or driver error text disclosed in a response
action: Catch driver exceptions at the application boundary and return a generic error page with a correlation id. Disable display_errors and mysqli exception reporting in production; log the original message server-side only.

title: Framework data-layer query exception disclosed in a response
action: Handle data-layer exceptions in the framework error handler and return a generic page. Set debug mode off in production so the exception renderer is never selected.

title: JavaScript ORM query exception disclosed in a response
action: Catch ORM errors in the request pipeline and return a generic error with a correlation id. Map known error codes to user-facing messages instead of rendering the exception.

title: Unix password database content served in a response
action: Fix the traversal or the static mapping that served the file; do not only block the string. Move the web root so it cannot contain parent traversal into /etc, and audit the access log for the request that produced this response.

title: PostgreSQL connection or authentication error text disclosed in a response
action: Return a generic error to the caller and log the libpq message server-side. Remove the PostgreSQL host, database and role from any user-visible error page.

title: Rails detailed exception page disclosed in a response
action: Set config.consider_all_requests_local = false in production and render a static error page. Never deploy with the detailed exception renderer enabled.

title: SQLite driver error text disclosed in a response
action: Catch SQLite exceptions and return a generic error. Never render the database file path in a response.

title: Symfony exception trace disclosed in a response
action: Run the application in production mode so the Twig error template is used, and return a generic page with a correlation id.

title: Windows ini file content served in a response
action: Fix the traversal or mapping that served the file and review the access log. Restrict the account running the service so it cannot read the system directory.

title: Location header carries an encoded line break
observes: the Location value against a pattern
action: Reject or strip CR and LF from any value placed in a response header, and validate redirect targets against an allow-list of paths or hosts.

title: Set-Cookie header carries an encoded line break
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Strip CR and LF from cookie values and encode them with a strict cookie encoder. Never build a Set-Cookie header from raw request data.

title: Classic ASP.NET error page disclosed in a response
action: Set <customErrors mode="On" /> (or On with a defaultRedirect) in Web.config and return a generic page with a correlation id.

title: ASP.NET trace application disclosed in a response
action: Disable tracing in production (<trace enabled="false" />) and block trace.axd at the web server. Treat every recorded request as disclosed.

title: iframe sandbox combines allow-scripts with allow-same-origin
action: Drop one of the two tokens. Serve untrusted content with allow-scripts only (and a separate origin), or with allow-same-origin only when no script is needed.

title: Node.js inspector debugging endpoint disclosed
action: Never bind the inspector to a public interface: start node with --inspect=127.0.0.1 (or omit it in production) and block the inspector port at the network boundary.

title: Served source map embeds the original source code
action: Build production maps without sourcesContent, serve maps only to authenticated users, or omit the maps from the public build.

title: Symfony VarDumper output disclosed in a response
action: Remove every dump/dd() call from a production build and disable the debug bundle outside development.

title: Xdebug variable dump disclosed in a response
