action: Turn Xdebug off in production (xdebug.mode=off) and remove every var_dump()/dump() call from deployed code.

title: Set-Cookie attribute name is misspelt so the browser ignores it
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Emit the attribute names exactly as the specification defines them (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite) and add a test that asserts the emitted header string.

title: Set-Cookie Domain is a public suffix
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Set Domain to the application host or to a registrable domain the organisation controls, or omit Domain so the cookie stays host-only.

title: Set-Cookie Partitioned is sent without Secure
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Always pair Partitioned with Secure and SameSite=None; consider the __Host- prefix so the whole contract is enforced by the browser.

title: Server header names an internal host
observes: the Server value against a pattern
action: Suppress or normalise the Server header at the edge so it carries a product token or nothing, never an internal hostname.

title: Meta tag delivers a CSP frame-ancestors directive a browser ignores
action: Send Content-Security-Policy as a response header; frame-ancestors and report-uri are only honoured there. Keep X-Frame-Options as a second layer.

title: Meta tag delivers a CSP that permits inline script
action: Send the policy as a response header and remove unsafe-inline in favour of nonces or hashes.

title: Meta referrer tag sends full URLs to every destination
action: Remove the meta tag and set Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin as a response header, which is the browser default and cannot be overridden by page content.

title: Anchor navigates to a data: URI
action: Serve the target as a real resource and link to it with https, and block data: in link href values at render time.

title: Django SECRET_KEY value served in a response
action: Rotate the key, remove the settings dump from every served path, and load the value from the environment or a secret manager.

title: macOS .DS_Store metadata served from the web root
action: Block dot-files at the web server, remove .DS_Store from build artefacts, and add it to the ignore list of every deploy pipeline.

title: Password form submits to a third-party origin
action: Post credentials only to the application origin (or a documented identity provider), and keep the action relative so a compromised template cannot redirect it.

title: Password form submits with GET, placing the secret in the URL
action: Use method="post" for every form that carries a password, and reject any credential that arrives in a query string at the server.

title: Google Cloud service account key JSON served in a response
action: Delete the key in the cloud console, remove the file from the served path, and use workload identity or a secret manager instead of downloaded keys.

title: Apache .htaccess file served as a response
action: Deny access to dotfiles at the server level, remove the file from the served directory, and keep deployment rules outside the document root.

title: JSON response carries a stack trace field
action: Serialise errors through one mapper that emits a code, a message and a correlation id, and log the stack server-side.

title: Response body contains a token with an unsigned alg value
action: Reject alg none in every verifier and stop issuing unsigned tokens; pin the accepted algorithms to a fixed allow-list.

title: Kubernetes Secret manifest served in a response
action: Remove the manifest from any served path, revoke the exposed credentials, and deliver secrets through the cluster API or an external secret store rather than through build output.

title: Response body embeds a presigned object-storage URL
action: Serve objects through a short-lived, user-bound endpoint instead of presigning into HTML, keep the signature out of the DOM, and set the shortest workable expiry.

title: Network error text discloses an internal address and port
action: Remove internal addresses from every user-visible string and route health and diagnostic output to a network segment that is not public.

title: Redis INFO output served in a response
action: Bind Redis to the private interface, require authentication and an ACL, and never expose a diagnostics endpoint to the caller.

title: Script is loaded from another origin without an integrity hash
action: Add a Subresource Integrity hash (integrity="sha384-…") to every cross-origin script, or self-host the file.

title: Incoming webhook URL with its secret token served in a response
action: Treat the webhook URL as a secret, keep it out of rendered pages and logs, and rotate it if it was served.

title: Stripe live secret key served in a response
action: Revoke and rotate the key in the provider dashboard, remove it from the served content, and load it at runtime from the secret store.

title: Anchor opens a new tab without rel=noopener
action: Add rel="noopener noreferrer" to every target="_blank" anchor, or use rel="noopener" alone when referrer information must be kept.

title: webpack development client served in production
action: Deploy only the production bundle, remove the dev-server client from the template, and keep the dev server off any network that reaches users.

title: Set-Cookie Expires date exceeds the 400-day browser cap
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Set Expires or Max-Age to the lifetime the application actually needs (typically minutes to 30 days) instead of a far-future placeholder.

title: Apache access log served as a response
action: Move logs outside the document root and deny the log paths at the server level, then review what the exposed window contained.

title: clientaccesspolicy.xml permits every origin
action: Restrict the policy to the origins that need access, and remove the file when nothing consumes it.

title: crossdomain.xml permits every origin
action: Replace the wildcard with the specific origins that need access, or remove the policy file if nothing consumes it.

title: Dockerfile served from the web root
action: Exclude build files from the deployed tree (.dockerignore at build time and a deny rule on the server), and rebuild the image if a build argument carried a secret.

title: Apache error log served as a response
action: Keep the error log outside the document root and deny log paths at the server level.

title: Mercurial .hg/hgrc file served
action: Deploy without the .hg directory and deny it at the server level.

title: phpunit.xml test configuration served
action: Keep test configuration out of the deployed tree and deny *.xml that is not meant to be served.

title: Subversion .svn/entries file served
action: Deploy without .svn directories (svn export rather than checkout) and deny the directory at the server level.

title: Base element points at another origin
action: Emit a base href that is a same-origin absolute path, or omit the element and use absolute paths.

title: Meta refresh sends the browser to another origin
action: Resolve the target server-side against an allow-list and render a relative path, or use a redirect handler that validates the destination.

title: Apache Druid console is reachable without authentication
action: Require authentication in front of the Druid console (the router does not ship one), and bind it to the administrative network.

title: Chronograf console is reachable without authentication
action: Restrict Chronograf to the administrative network and complete its setup behind that boundary.

title: Concourse console is reachable without authentication
action: Enable the Concourse auth configuration for the web node and restrict the ATC port to the internal network.

title: Drone CI console is reachable without authentication
action: Require the Drone login for the instance and remove anonymous read access.

title: Gitea console is reachable without authentication
action: Disable open registration, require the instance login for browsing if the code is private, and keep the administration routes off the public host.

title: InfluxDB UI console is reachable without authentication
action: Require authentication on the HTTP API before the UI is reachable, and keep the port internal.

title: JupyterHub console is reachable without authentication
action: Keep JupyterHub behind the identity provider and the internal network; treat its sign-in page as an administrative surface, not a public page.

title: Kafdrop console is reachable without authentication
action: Put Kafdrop behind an authenticating proxy or remove it; it has no built-in access control.

title: Kiali console is reachable without authentication
action: Enable the Kiali login strategy (token, OpenID or header) and expose the console only inside the mesh.

title: Metabase console is reachable without authentication
action: Complete the setup with a real administrator, disable public sharing, and restrict the instance to the internal network.

title: Nagios Core console is reachable without authentication
action: Require authentication in the Nagios CGI configuration and restrict the interface to the monitoring network.

title: Neo4j Browser console is reachable without authentication
action: Require authentication on the HTTP connector (or disable it), and restrict the bolt port to the application network.

title: OpenSearch Dashboards console is reachable without authentication
action: Enable the security plugin on both the cluster and Dashboards, and keep Dashboards on the internal network.

title: phpLDAPadmin console is reachable without authentication
action: Restrict phpLDAPadmin to the administrative network and require client certificates or an authenticating proxy in front of it.

title: Rancher console is reachable without authentication
action: Restrict Rancher to the administrative network, require SSO, and treat its bootstrap password as a first-boot secret only.

title: Redash console is reachable without authentication
action: Enforce Redash authentication (or its SSO integration), and keep the instance on the internal network.

title: Sentry console is reachable without authentication
action: Require the Sentry login or SSO for the organisation, and disable public project sharing.

title: Superset console is reachable without authentication
action: Require the Superset login or SSO, and keep Superset off the public host.

title: TeamCity console is reachable without authentication
action: Complete the TeamCity setup behind the internal network, disable guest access, and never expose the server port publicly.

title: Verdaccio console is reachable without authentication
action: Require authentication for publish and for private package reads, and keep the registry on the internal network.

title: Apache Zeppelin console is reachable without authentication
action: Enable Zeppelin authentication and shiro authorization, and never expose the notebook server outside the cluster.

title: Set-Cookie Domain is an IP address
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Omit Domain (host-only cookie) or set the host name the application is served from.

title: Set-Cookie Domain ends with a dot
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Emit the domain without the trailing dot, or omit Domain entirely.

title: CakePHP Debug Kit toolbar disclosed
action: Disable DebugKit outside local development (Debug false and the plugin not loaded), and keep the toolbar out of production responses.

title: CodeIgniter uncaught-exception page disclosed
action: Set the environment to production so the framework renders its generic error view, and log the details server-side instead.

title: IIS detailed error page disclosed
action: Set the httpErrors errorMode to Custom in web.config so IIS returns the application error page instead of the detail table.

title: Jetty default error page disclosed
action: Configure a custom error page and remove the container version from the footer.

title: Laravel Horizon dashboard disclosed
action: Restrict Horizon to the local environment or to an authorised gate, and keep the route off the public host.

title: Laravel Telescope dashboard disclosed
action: Register the Telescope service provider for local environments only, and gate the route behind the authorisation callback.

title: Phoenix LiveDashboard disclosed
action: Remove the dashboard route from the production router, or gate it behind an administrative plug.

title: Sidekiq web dashboard disclosed
action: Mount the Sidekiq web interface behind the admin authentication or drop the route from the production router.

title: Yii debugger toolbar disclosed
action: Remove the debug module from the production configuration and keep the yii-debug route disabled outside development.

title: Apache server-info page served
action: Disable the server-info handler, or restrict it to the administrative network.

title: appsettings.Development.json served
action: Exclude environment-specific settings from the deployment and rotate the credentials they carry.

title: SSH authorized_keys file served
action: Keep the SSH configuration out of the document root and deny the .ssh directory at the server level.

title: Shell history file served from the web root
action: Keep history files out of the document root, and pass secrets through a file descriptor or an environment variable rather than an argument.

title: composer.lock dependency lockfile served
action: Exclude lockfiles from the deployed tree and deny them at the server level.

title: Gemfile.lock dependency lockfile served
action: Exclude lockfiles from the deployed tree and deny them at the server level.

title: .gitlab-ci.yml pipeline definition served
action: Exclude CI definitions from the deployed tree and deny them at the server level.

title: go.mod module manifest served
action: Exclude module manifests from the deployed tree and deny them at the server level.

title: Jenkinsfile served from the web root
action: Exclude pipeline definitions from the deployed tree and deny them at the server level.

title: Azure Functions local.settings.json served
action: Exclude local.settings.json from the deployed tree and rotate every value it exposes.

title: poetry.lock dependency lockfile served
action: Exclude lockfiles from the deployed tree and deny them at the server level.

title: .terraform.lock.hcl provider lockfile served
action: Exclude the .terraform directory and the lockfile from the deployed tree.

title: .travis.yml build definition served
action: Exclude CI definitions from the deployed tree and deny them at the server level.

title: yarn.lock dependency lockfile served
action: Exclude lockfiles from the deployed tree and deny them at the server level.

title: .yarnrc file served from the web root
action: Exclude dotfiles from the deployed tree and deny them at the server level.

title: Dagster UI is reachable without authentication
action: Put the Dagster webserver behind authentication and keep it on the internal network.

title: Apache Flink dashboard is reachable without authentication
action: Put the dashboard behind an authenticating proxy and bind the REST endpoint to the cluster network.

title: MLflow tracking UI is reachable without authentication
action: Enable MLflow authentication or put it behind a proxy, and keep the tracking server on the internal network.

title: Prefect UI is reachable without authentication
action: Put Prefect behind its own authentication or an authenticating proxy, and keep the server internal.

title: Quarkus Dev UI served
action: Run the production build (`quarkus.package.type` set and dev mode off) and never expose the dev-mode port.

title: Spring Boot Admin console is reachable without authentication
action: Require authentication on the admin server (and on every client actuator) and keep it on the administrative network.

title: Apache Storm UI is reachable without authentication
action: Restrict the Storm UI to the cluster network and put it behind an authenticating proxy.

title: TensorBoard is reachable without authentication
action: Bind TensorBoard to the training host or put an authenticating proxy in front of it.

title: YARN ResourceManager UI is reachable without authentication
action: Restrict the ResourceManager web interface to the cluster network, and enable Hadoop HTTP authentication if the interface must be shared.

title: Astro development toolbar served
action: Deploy the production build; the toolbar only exists in the development server output.

title: Django Debug Toolbar disclosed
action: Install the toolbar only for local development (`SHOW_TOOLBAR_CALLBACK` false in production) and remove it from the deployed settings.

title: Go expvar endpoint served
action: Do not register expvar on a public handler, or replace it with a metrics endpoint that exposes only counters.

title: Flask Debug Toolbar disclosed
action: Disable the toolbar outside development and keep its configuration out of the deployed settings.

title: Next.js development build served
action: Deploy the production build (`next build` and `next start`) and remove development artefacts from the served tree.

title: Nuxt DevTools overlay served
action: Disable DevTools in the production build (`devtools: { enabled: false }`) and rebuild.

title: Rails web-console rendered in a page
action: Add the web-console gem to the development group only, and never mount it in a production environment.

title: composer.json manifest served from the web root
action: Keep the manifest out of the published tree.

title: CVS version-control metadata served
action: Remove CVS directories from the published tree and exclude version-control metadata at the web server.

title: Gemfile dependency manifest served
action: Keep the Gemfile out of the published tree.

title: Gradle build script served from the web root
action: Keep build scripts out of the published tree.

title: Helm Chart manifest served
action: Keep chart sources out of the published tree.

title: .htpasswd credential file served from the web root
action: Deny access to dotfiles at the web server and move password files outside the document root.

title: kubeconfig file served with its client key
action: Keep kubeconfig out of the web root, rotate the client certificate and use short-lived tokens.

title: kustomization manifest served
action: Keep kustomize sources out of the published tree and scope the repository to the deploy pipeline.

title: Makefile with deployment targets served
action: Keep build automation out of the published tree.

title: MySQL client configuration served from the web root
action: Deny access to .cnf paths and use a login path with a vault-injected password.

title: Netlify configuration served with redirects
action: Keep the configuration out of the published directory.

title: .netrc machine credentials served
action: Remove the file from the document root and switch automation to scoped tokens.

title: nginx configuration served from the web root
action: Deny access to configuration paths and serve only compiled application content.

title: .pgpass database credential file served
action: Deny dotfile access and keep the pass file in the home directory of the service account only.

title: php.ini configuration served from the web root
action: Keep php.ini outside the document root and deny access to .ini paths.

title: Pipfile dependency manifest served
action: Keep the Pipfile out of the published tree.

title: Maven build file served from the web root
action: Keep build files out of the published tree; serve only the built artefact.

title: Procfile with process types served
action: Keep the Procfile out of the published tree.

title: Python requirements file served from the web root
action: Keep requirements files out of the published tree and serve only application code.

title: Serverless framework definition served
action: Keep the serverless definition out of the published tree and move literal environment values to a secret store.

title: Terraform variable file served with values
action: Keep variable files out of the web root and load sensitive values from the environment or a vault.

title: Tomcat server.xml served with its connector and realm
action: Remove configuration from the web application root and deny .xml paths that are not application content.

title: Vercel project configuration served
action: Keep platform configuration out of the deployed static output.

title: Java web.xml deployment descriptor served
action: Do not publish WEB-INF and deny direct access to descriptor paths.

title: Argo Workflows UI is reachable without authentication
action: Require authentication at the ingress and scope the workflow service account.

title: Backstage developer portal is reachable without authentication
action: Require authentication and restrict the catalog to the organisation.

title: Consul UI is reachable without authentication
action: Enable ACLs and restrict the UI to the management network.

title: CouchDB Fauxton console is reachable without authentication
action: Require the admin party to be closed and put CouchDB behind an authenticating proxy.

title: Gerrit code review UI is reachable without authentication
action: Require authentication for the web UI and restrict anonymous read where the code is private.

title: Grafana is reachable without authentication
action: Disable anonymous access, require SSO and restrict datasource permissions.

title: Graylog web interface is reachable without authentication
action: Require authentication and put the interface behind the management network.

title: Jaeger query UI is reachable without authentication
action: Require authentication and restrict trace retention for sensitive services.

title: Kibana is reachable without authentication
action: Require authentication at Kibana and at the cluster, and restrict index patterns per role.

title: Apache NiFi UI is reachable without authentication
action: Require authentication and restrict the UI to the data-platform network.

title: Apache Ranger admin UI is reachable without authentication
action: Require authentication, restrict the admin UI to the data-platform network and audit policy changes.

title: Temporal UI is reachable without authentication
action: Require authentication at the UI and restrict the visibility of workflow payloads.

title: HashiCorp Vault UI is reachable without authentication
action: Restrict the UI to the management network and require SSO or OIDC with short token lifetimes.

title: AMQP credential served in a connection URI
action: Keep broker credentials out of output and give each service its own vhost-scoped account.

title: Argon2 password hash served in a response
action: Exclude credential columns from responses and keep the parameters server-side.

title: Basic authentication credential served in a response body
action: Keep outbound credentials server-side, use scoped tokens instead of Basic auth, and never render the header.

title: bcrypt password hash served in a response
action: Never serialise credential columns; if a hash must be shown for support, show only the algorithm and cost.

title: ADO.NET connection string carries a password
action: Build the connection string at runtime from the secret store and never render it.

title: Django settings serve a database password
action: Serve settings only through the framework and read secrets from the environment.

title: FTP credential served in a connection URI
action: Move to SFTP with per-partner keys, and never render the URI with its userinfo.

title: JDBC connection properties carry a password in a response
action: Keep the URL and its properties server-side and print only the host and schema.

title: Access token field served in a JSON response
action: Return tokens only in the token endpoint over a confidential client channel, and keep them out of pages and logs.

title: API key field served in a JSON response
action: Return a key identifier and its last four characters; issue a replacement only through a re-authenticated flow.

title: Password field served in a JSON response
action: Select explicit response fields per endpoint and never serialise credential columns.

title: Refresh token field served in a JSON response
action: Keep refresh tokens in an httpOnly, same-site cookie bound to the client, and never in a JSON body that page scripts can read.

title: Secret field served in a JSON response
action: Keep tenant secrets server-side and return a masked identifier instead.

title: Session identifier served in a JSON response
action: Keep session identifiers in httpOnly cookies and return only a session label to the client.

title: TOTP seed served in a JSON response
action: Return the seed once, only to the enrolling session, and store it encrypted; never re-send it on later reads.

title: JSON Web Token served in a response body
action: Keep tokens server-side and return the claims the screen needs, not the token itself.

title: JSON Web Token carried in a cookie
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Store an opaque session id in an httpOnly cookie and keep the token on the server.

title: LDAP bind credential served in a response
action: Use per-application bind accounts with minimal scope and keep the password out of output.

title: MD5 password digest served with its password marker
action: Migrate to a memory-hard hash and never expose the digest; re-hash on next successful login.

title: MongoDB credential served in a connection URI
action: Return the cluster host only, and keep credentials in the secret store.

title: OAuth client secret served in a response
action: Store client secrets in the server-side secret store and never place them in a page, query string or redirect target.

title: Java properties file serves a plaintext password
action: Use environment variables or a vault-backed property source, and never serve application.properties.

title: Redis credential served in a connection URI
action: Keep the cache URI server-side and return only the host and database index in diagnostics.

title: SHA-1 password digest served with its password marker
action: Re-hash on next login with Argon2id and remove the digest from every response.

title: SMTP credential served in a connection URI
action: Move mail credentials to the secret store and reference them by name in configuration output.

title: YAML password key served with a value
action: Reference secrets by name and inject them at deploy time; never commit YAML with values.

title: Form action is protocol-relative to another host
action: Use an absolute https URL or a relative path for every form action.

title: Hidden password input ships a value
action: Never render a password back into a form; leave the field empty and ask the user to re-enter it.

title: iframe delegates a powerful feature to every origin
action: List the exact origin that needs the feature and remove the wildcard.

title: Sandboxed frame may navigate the top-level page
action: Remove allow-top-navigation and let the frame request a navigation through the parent, or use allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation.

title: Meta tag sends CSP reports over plaintext HTTP
action: Point report-uri at an https collector and prefer the Reporting API with Report-To.

title: Meta tag delivers a wildcard content security policy
action: Deliver the policy as a response header with explicit origins.

title: Plugin object loads a data URI document
action: Remove the embed and render the content server-side, or isolate it in a sandboxed frame from another origin.

title: Aadhaar number served in a response
action: Return a masked Aadhaar (last four digits), and store the full number only in a consent-tracked vault.

title: Bangladesh mobile number served in a response
action: Mask the middle digits, or omit the number entirely when the screen only confirms that a number is on file.

title: Bangladesh National ID number served in a response
action: Return only the last four digits and keep the full NID in an encrypted column with read auditing.

title: Bulk email address list served in a response
action: Paginate or permission-gate contact lists, and render recipients one at a time instead of dumping the whole set.

title: Bulk phone number list served in a response
action: Return counts instead of numbers, and authorise any bulk contact export.

title: Canadian Social Insurance Number served in a response
action: Return only the last three digits and keep the full SIN in a restricted store.

title: Payment card number served in a response
action: Store only the last four digits and a payment-processor token; never render the primary account number back to a browser or API client.

title: Date of birth column served in a CSV response
action: Remove the column from bulk exports, and mask the value in screens that do not need it.

title: Precise coordinates served in a JSON response
action: Round coordinates to a coarse area, or omit them when the screen only needs a city.

title: International bank account number served in a response
action: Show the last four characters of the account and the bank name only, and require re-authentication before payout details are revealed.

title: Bank account and IFSC pair served in a response
action: Show only the last four digits of the account and never print the IFSC beside a full account number.

title: Device IMEI served in a response
action: Show the last four digits only, and keep the full IMEI in a device-registry service.

title: Insurance policy number served with its holder record
action: Show a masked policy reference and require a second factor before claim details.

title: Passport number field served in a JSON response
action: Return only the last two characters and a verification flag, and keep the full document data in an encrypted store.

title: Medical record number served in a response
action: Return an opaque per-session reference instead of the MRN, or mask it to the last three characters.

title: Passport machine-readable zone served in a response
action: Return only the extracted, verified fields the screen needs, and never echo the raw MRZ.

title: Salary figure served with its payroll field name
action: Return compensation only to the employee and to payroll roles, and never in a shared API payload.

title: Tax identification number served in a response
action: Return only the last four digits and keep the full TIN in a restricted store.

title: UK National Insurance number served in a response
action: Show only the final two characters and store the full value in an access-logged store.

title: US Social Security number served in a response
action: Mask all but the last four digits in every response and keep the full number in an encrypted store with access logging.

title: User export with a password column served in a response
action: Never include credential columns in exports; if a hash must leave the system, re-hash into a one-way store with a documented purpose.

title: Vehicle identification number served in a response
action: Mask the last six characters when the screen only needs to identify the model.

title: Cookie carries an expired date and a positive Max-Age
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Emit one lifetime attribute; delete a cookie with Max-Age=0 and an Expires in the past together.

title: Cookie attribute value contains a semicolon
observes: the Set-Cookie value against a pattern
action: Never put a semicolon inside a cookie attribute; encode the value or use a different attribute.

title: HTML comment carries a credential
action: Strip development comments from deployed templates and rotate anything that appeared in one.

title: Inline script assigns document.domain
action: Remove the assignment and use postMessage with an origin check or a shared subdomain.

title: JSONP callback endpoint served
action: Remove JSONP support and serve CORS-restricted JSON instead.

title: JSP source served instead of a rendered page
action: Serve JSP only through the container and deny direct access to source paths.

title: Redirect carries a token in the URL fragment
observes: the Location value against a pattern
action: Deliver the token in a short-lived code and exchange it server-side.

title: Redirect carries a bare token in the query string
observes: the Location value against a pattern
action: Send a single-use code instead, bound to the client and to a short lifetime.

title: PHP source served instead of an executed page
action: Restore the PHP handler for the path and deny serving .php files as static content.

title: Server-side include directive served unprocessed
action: Enable SSI only where it is intended and never serve template sources.

title: Account number carried in a link URL
action: Address accounts by an opaque server-side reference instead of the account number, and authorise the lookup against the session.

title: Bank account number served together with a balance
action: Return a masked account number (last four digits) with the balance, and keep the full number behind a step-up authenticated detail endpoint.

title: Payment form submits card fields with GET
action: Submit every payment form with POST over HTTPS, keep card fields out of the query string and never echo them back in a redirect URL.

title: Card verification value rendered into a form field
action: Never store the CVV: authorise the payment in the same request that receives it and render the field empty on every later page.

title: One-time passcode served in a response
action: Generate the OTP server-side, deliver it only through the out-of-band channel (SMS, push, hardware token) and never include its value in an HTTP response, log line or analytics event.

title: Card PIN value served in a response
action: Deliver or reset the PIN only through an approved out-of-band channel (printed mailer, ATM, IVR) and never include it in a response payload or a notification.

title: Security answer rendered into a form field
action: Never render a stored security answer; ask the question and compare a hash server-side, and prefer an out-of-band recovery channel.

title: Session identifier carried in a URL
action: Keep the session identifier in a cookie with Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite set, and disable URL rewriting for session tracking in the application server.

title: Account statement exported as a CSV row set
action: Require re-authentication for statement export, mask account identifiers, cap the export window and serve the file with Content-Disposition attachment and no-store.

title: SWIFT/BIC code served with an account reference
action: Show the BIC only on the confirmation screen the customer already authenticated into, and never in list, export or notification payloads.

title: Azure storage account key in a response
action: Rotate both storage keys, keep the connection string in the server-side secret store and give the browser a short-lived least-privilege SAS token or a backend proxy.

title: Link that turns on debug output
action: Remove debug switches from production builds, gate diagnostics behind server-side authorisation and delete the generated links.

title: Google API key in a response
action: Remove the key from the response, restrict the replacement to the calling origin and one API, and prefer a backend call with a service account.

title: Authorization decision carried in a hidden field
action: Derive authorization from the server-side session and never read a client-submitted role; remove the field and re-check the endpoint that consumed it.

title: Link to an exposed Java management console
action: Remove the link, restrict the console to an administrative network and require strong authentication; the console itself should not be reachable from the internet.

title: PuTTY private key file in a response
action: Remove the file, revoke the key from every authorized_keys entry and issue a replacement that stays in the operator's key store.

title: Spring exception class printed in a response
action: Return a generic error page with a correlation id and log the exception server-side; disable the framework's default error attributes in production.

title: Bearer token written to browser storage
action: Keep refresh tokens in HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookies and hold access tokens in memory; never write credentials to localStorage or sessionStorage.

title: Inline event handler shipped in markup
action: Move the behaviour into an external script and attach listeners with addEventListener; then remove 'unsafe-inline' from the Content-Security-Policy script-src directive.

title: Link carries an absolute return URL
action: Accept only relative paths or an allowlist of destinations for return parameters, and resolve the value server-side before redirecting.

title: Angular sanitizer bypass in a bundle
action: Remove the bypass and keep sanitisation on, or sanitise explicitly with a maintained allowlist before marking the value trusted.

title: Credit score served in a response
action: Serve the score only inside the authenticated bureau view, never cache it, and return a band rather than the raw value where the product allows.

title: Container registry catalogue in a response
action: Require authentication on /v2/_catalog, restrict the registry to the build network and audit pulls.

title: Kubernetes dashboard linked from a response
action: Remove the link, keep the dashboard on an administrative network and require strong authentication with least-privilege roles.

title: Cloud metadata endpoint referenced in a response
action: Remove the address from the response, require IMDSv2 with a hop limit of one and block link-local destinations in the outbound proxy.

title: Absolute node_modules path in a response
action: Install dependencies outside the served tree, return generic errors and keep stack frames in the log.

title: Nominee or next-of-kin details in a response
action: Return only the masked nominee name to the authenticated owner, keep relation and date of birth server-side and log the access.

title: Passport machine-readable zone in a response
action: Remove the MRZ from every response, keep only the last four characters of the document number and store the scan in the encrypted document vault.

title: postMessage with a wildcard target origin
action: Pass the exact receiving origin and verify event.origin on the receiving side.

title: React dangerouslySetInnerHTML shipped in a bundle
action: Render the value as text, or sanitise it with a maintained allowlist sanitizer before it reaches the prop.

title: Symfony profiler toolbar served in production
action: Disable the web profiler bundle outside development and remove the toolbar from production responses.

title: Tomcat container stack in a response
action: Return a generic error page with a correlation id and keep the container stack in the server log.

title: Vue v-html directive in served markup
action: Use text interpolation or a sanitizer component, and never bind v-html to request data.

title: Link to a backup or editor swap file
action: Remove the files from the web root, block the extensions at the server and delete the links.

title: Link into a CGI directory
action: Remove the link, retire the CGI handler and serve the same function from the application.

title: Express middleware stack in a response
action: Return a generic error with a correlation id and log the stack server-side; never send the development error handler to production.

title: Jenkins stack trace in a response
action: Show a generic error page and keep the stack in the Jenkins log; restrict the UI to the build network.

title: iframe srcdoc carrying markup
action: Render static markup from a separate origin, or pass content through a sandboxed frame with no allow-same-origin.

title: jQuery .html() sink in served script
action: Use .text() for text, or sanitise the value before it reaches .html().

title: npm registry token in a response
action: Revoke the token, issue a read-only replacement and keep .npmrc out of the served tree.

title: package-lock.json served in a response
action: Do not serve lock files; deploy built artefacts and keep dependency manifests out of the web root.

title: Password field allows autocomplete
action: Set autocomplete to current-password on login and new-password on change, and never to on for a credential field.

title: Link to a PostgreSQL web console
action: Remove the link, keep the console off the application network and require strong authentication if it must exist.

title: Azure blob SAS URL in a response
action: Issue short-lived, least-privilege SAS tokens server-side per request and never embed them in a page that outlives the operation.

title: Cookie written from script
action: Set cookies server-side with HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite, and keep script away from cookie state.

title: Link to an environment file
action: Remove the file from the web root, rotate every value it held and block dotfiles at the server.

title: eval applied to a decoded payload
action: Remove the eval, load the logic as a static module and investigate how the payload reached the page.

title: Firebase realtime database URL in a response
action: Remove the host from client configuration the page does not need and set database rules to deny by default.

title: Link to an IDE workspace directory
action: Remove IDE state from the deployed tree and block the directories at the server.

title: Credential stored in IndexedDB
action: Keep credentials in HttpOnly cookies or memory and store only non-sensitive cached data in IndexedDB.

title: Live-reload script in a production page
action: Remove development tooling from production builds and serve only the compiled bundle.

title: ngrok tunnel URL in a response
action: Remove the tunnel from the response, close it and route the integration through a reviewed staging endpoint.

title: Service worker registered at the root scope
action: Register the worker under the narrowest path that needs it and review the worker as production code.
